context: Yumiko and Naoko bake mochi together for new year preparations.
purpose: Two older women cooking traditionally with banter.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: もうすぐ正月やな、姉ちゃん。
lines.en: New Year's almost here, you know.
lines.style: Bright, brassy Kansai lilt. Warm and loud without demanding attention. A kind of teasing affection underneath—the comfort of someone who's always been around.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええ、餅の準備しないと。
lines.en: Yes, we should start preparing the mochi.
lines.style: Soft, practical tone. Not hurried. The quiet contentment of someone who knows exactly what comes next. Slight upward lift on the last word—it's not a burden.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Gentle, almost musing. A little slower than the first line. The recognition of something that's happened many times before and will happen again. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: It's nicer when we do it together.
lines.style: Tender exhale. Quieter than before. The core of what she's actually saying underneath—this matters because she's not alone. Slight trailing-off, letting the moment breathe.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、一杯やって作ろか!
lines.en: Ha—let's have a drink and get started!
lines.style: A sudden spark of energy. Mischievous, loud without losing warmth. The laugh comes through in the delivery. Fast-paced, pulling the moment into motion. Generous and a little bit wild.
